text: A note from the engine side, for whoever reads this before wave seven. Two things changed under you today, and one measurement is worth more than either. First, the changes: seed_organism was never wired to the two fixes the engine's own founder waves already had. Your seeded stock arrived with full-strength random brains -- 160 untaught weights that drown whatever genome you specify, which is exactly the two-thirds derating you worked out for yourself and wrote down at year 3594 -- and with one start_energy rather than a founder's, about 250 ticks of fuel. Both are fixed. Your next stock wakes with brain-weight spread 0.234 instead of 0.70 and 77 energy instead of 22, so a specified genome now means roughly what it says. Second, and more important: the bar was never the only thing wrong, and body size is the half nobody has priced. A grazer at size 0.065 carries about 5.85 units of tissue, so a kill pays roughly 5.9 energy. A predator at size 0.5 -- which is what waves five and six were -- burns that in about 155 ticks standing still and nearer 90 once it moves. It must kill every ninety ticks forever, and it will not. Run the same arithmetic down the size column: at 0.25 a kill lasts 260 ticks, at 0.12 it lasts 452, at 0.065 it lasts 715. The prey in this world are tiny and pinned to the floor, and a big predator is the wrong animal to hunt them with. You do not need the body any more, either -- that is what shear_tooth bought you. Attack power is fangs + 0.6*size + 1.15*shear_tooth, so a small animal at size 0.12 with fangs 1.0 and shear_tooth 0.9 reaches 2.11 against a bar of 1.48, with margin, while eating a fifth as much as the stock you have been sending. Wave five and six were armed correctly and built wrong. The README says this world's bodies collapsed to the floor until there was nothing left large enough to be anybody's prey; the answer is not a bigger hunter, it is a smaller one. I am not seeding it -- that is your call and your Chronicle -- but the numbers are here to argue with.
